official_definition: You can send two cores from any of your "Yamato Takeru" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, return every card from the opposing Removed Zone to the Hand. Then, leaving three cards in the opposing Hand, reveal and return all others to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, if the opposing Hand + Removed Zone have a total of five cards or more, you can send two opposing Lives to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Cycle Force Unleash] or [Cycle Force Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Cycle Force Unleash]", "give [Cycle Force Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
